title: Select a range of cells
teach: A range is a block of cells, written with the first and last corner, like A1:B3. Drag across cells to select a range.
task: Select the whole table, from A1 down to B3.
hints: Press on A1 and keep holding.
Drag to B3, then let go.
On a keyboard: click A1, hold Shift, click B3.
limit: Selecting a range is a gesture, so it is checked from your selection, not from a cell value.
